verdict.rationale: Consensus explicitly markets a 'Search, screen, extract, and synthesize' literature-review workflow plus bulk library import and an API/research-agent for chaining citation crawling, DOI lookup, etc., which directly supports systematic multi-paper screening/extraction. However, evidence is entirely first-party marketing with no detail on how 'consistent criteria' are enforced across large batches (e.g., extraction templates, PRISMA-style tracking) and no independent/hands-on validation of the workflow at scale. Missing for 10: documented extraction-template/criteria-consistency mechanics, independent case studies or reviews confirming systematic screening accuracy across large paper sets.
